sloka: एते हि तापसावासा दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे ।अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानप्रभः ।अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी ।। ६.१२६.४५ ।।
transliteration: ete hi tāpasāvāsā dṛśyante tanumadhyame ।atriḥ kulapatiryatra sūryavaiśvānaprabhaḥ ।atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharmacāriṇī ।। 6.126.45 ।।

translations.english: "Sita, here is Janasthana, where a mighty tree is seen. Oh sportive lady! There the exceptionally strong and highly energetic vulture Jatayu got killed by Ravana on account of you."
